description: This Java class implements a specialized loan repayment schedule transaction processor that handles payments including due penalties, fees, interest, principal, in advance principal, penalties, and fees, with specific logic for on-time, late, and in-advance transactions in a loan management system.

classes.name: DuePenFeeIntPriInAdvancePriPenFeeIntLoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor
classes.description: A specialized transaction processor class for handling complex loan repayment scenarios involving penalties, fees, interest, principal, including in-advance and late payments, following a specific component payment order.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsPaymentInAdvanceOfInstallment
methods.description: Handles transactions that represent payments made in advance of scheduled installment due date, allocating amounts to penalties, fees, interest, and principal accordingly.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsALateRepaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Handles late repayment transactions, delegating behavior to on-time processing in this implementation.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsOnTimePaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Handles normal, on-time loan repayment transactions, distributing the payment across penalty, fee, interest, and principal components.

methods.name: handleRefundTransactionPaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Handles refund scenarios, unpaying components accordingly.
